message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: The husband (Zhang) asked hospital to abandon treatment and gave the twins to a taxi driver to abandon. No. Could be "危害公共安全"? No. Could be "非法组织收养"? Not. The act of abandoning infants is a crime under Article 260 of Criminal Law: "遗弃婴幼儿、患病、残疾或者年老体弱的亲属" etc. So the crime is "遗弃罪".
